### Course Objective

This course aims to expose students to leading international perspectives, emerging knowledge, and innovative practices in sustainability through a series of lectures delivered by distinguished scholars and experts from around the world. The course introduces a range of contemporary sustainability issues and enables students to understand how different countries, institutions, and sectors address complex environmental, social, and economic challenges. Through these lectures, students will broaden their global perspectives, enhance their understanding of current developments in sustainable development, and strengthen their ability to recognize important sustainability challenges and emerging solutions.
